review:
A genie on a 6x4 ways grid, with a twist on Beam Boys' wild rows. Genies land on reels 2 to 6 and blow clouds to the left along their row – every spot under a cloud turns wild, so a genie on the far right can make the whole row wild.

FS symbols still count under a cloud as long as they're part of a win, so you don't lose bonus triggers to your own wilds. The Arabian Nights bonus and its upgrades bring more genies. 10,000x max.
